thesis: The episode discusses Apple's new AI features, noting that while some tools like visual intelligence and photo editing are helpful, the most game-changing capability is media search, which allows users to find specific moments in videos using natural language. The speakers also express disappointment that Siri has not yet received a true AI-native upgrade to become action-oriented, despite Apple having the unique permissioning and access across all apps required to make that happen.
